package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"log"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"strconv"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/config"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/aiprompt"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/competency"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/practice"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/runtimecatalog"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/sandbox"
	validationclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/validation"
	postgresrepo "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	httptransport "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/transport/http"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/usecase"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

const authoringHTTPWriteTimeout = 20 * time.Minute

func main() {
	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(context.Background(), cfg.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	pingCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	err = pool.Ping(pingCtx)
	cancel()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	planner := usecase.Planner{
		Jobs:         postgresrepo.JobRepository{Pool: pool},
		Generator:    aiprompt.Client{BaseURL: cfg.AIPromptURL, InternalToken: cfg.AIPromptToken},
		Competencies: competency.Client{BaseURL: cfg.LearningPlannerURL, InternalToken: cfg.LearningPlannerToken},
		Profiles:     runtimecatalog.Client{BaseURL: cfg.SandboxURL, InternalToken: cfg.SandboxToken},
		Validation:   validationclient.Client{BaseURL: cfg.ValidationURL, InternalToken: cfg.ValidationToken},
		Workspaces:   sandbox.Client{BaseURL: cfg.SandboxURL, InternalToken: cfg.SandboxToken},
		Stager:       practice.Client{BaseURL: cfg.PracticeURL, StagingToken: cfg.PracticeStagingToken},
		Policy: domain.GenerationPolicy{
			PlannerVersion: "tz-planner-v1", GenerationPolicyVersion: "task-authoring-v1",
			TechnicalTaskSchema: domain.TechnicalTaskSchemaV1, PromptTemplateRef: "practice-task.authoring-candidate.v1@2",
			Tone: "supportive_direct", Methodology: "incremental_evidence_first",
			SkillRefs: []string{"task_analysis.v1", "meaningful_variant_design.v1", "step_decomposition.v1", "competency_mapping.v1", "evaluation_design.v1", "traceability_audit.v1"},
		},
	}
	handler := httptransport.Handler{Planner: planner, InternalToken: cfg.InternalAPIToken, Health: pool}
	server := &http.Server{Addr: net.JoinHostPort(cfg.HTTPHost, strconv.Itoa(cfg.HTTPPort)), Handler: handler.Router(), ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second, ReadTimeout: 15 * time.Second, WriteTimeout: authoringHTTPWriteTimeout, IdleTimeout: 60 * time.Second, MaxHeaderBytes: 32 << 10}
	go func() {
		if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
	}()
	signals := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(signals, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	<-signals
	shutdownCtx, shutdownCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer shutdownCancel()
	if err := server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil {
		log.Printf("shutdown: %v", err)
	}
}
